title: Putnami Toolchain Resolve Result
description: Toolchain-resolve protocol v1. An extension answers the core's toolchainResolveRequest, sent through `<executable> __putnami toolchain-resolve`, with this result: the lock's next state for each asked identity. A pin is what the lock records; a problem fails the install and is shown with its remedy; an asked identity the result omits has no pin, because the workspace declares no release of it.

version.description: Toolchain-resolve protocol version. A mismatch is rejected, never guessed at.

extension.description: Name of the answering extension. It must be the extension the request asked.

toolchains.description: Resolution of each asked identity, keyed by identity. Every key is an identity the request asks for.

identity.description: Toolchain lock identity: the key of a lock's toolchains entry, and the rule an extension manifest applies to each runtime.resolves entry.

platform.description: Platform: an "os/arch" pair as Go spells them, such as "darwin/arm64".

toolchainResolveRequest.description: The core's question to one extension. It carries no paths: the core runs the executable with the workspace root as its working directory and the probe's timeout.

extension.description: Asked extension name, echoed back in the result so a misrouted answer is detectable.

identities.description: Lock identities asked: the extension's runtime.resolves, sorted.

locked.description: The workspace lock's committed entries for asked identities, as committed: a lock version 3, 4 or 5 toolchain entry. Every key is an asked identity.

platform.description: Host platform. Every pin the answer records must cover it.

offline.description: Answer without the network: from the committed pins, the workspace's declarations and the extension's own knowledge.

lockedToolchainEntry.description: A committed lock toolchain entry in the vocabulary of its lock version: version 5 records archives, versions 3 and 4 record source. The request carries it as committed, and the protocol does not validate it again.

toolchainResolution.description: The answer for one identity: exactly one of pin and problem.

pin.description: A lock version 5 toolchain entry, which the lock records as written. It covers the request's platform with both an integrity and an archive.

toolchainProblem.description: Why the extension cannot pin an identity. It fails the install and is shown with its remedy.

remedy.description: What to change, such as the declaration to write.
